<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Reorder" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/inventory-reorder">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryReorder" name="Inventory Reorder Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Monitoring" name="Process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ToMonitorMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MonitorMerge" name="Monitoring cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ToMonitorMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotReached_Loop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorMerge_ToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorMerge_ToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_ToThresholdSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdSplit" name="Threshold reached?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_ToThresholdSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reached_ToSignalSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotReached_Loop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalSplit" name="Reorder signal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reached_ToSignalSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SignalSplit_ToAlert</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SignalSplit_ToManualCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Send automated reorder alert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SignalSplit_ToAlert</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Alert_ToSignalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual stock check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SignalSplit_ToManualCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ManualCheck_ToSignalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalJoin" name="Reorder needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Alert_ToSignalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ManualCheck_ToSignalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SignalJoin_ToPlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with suppliers">
      <bpmn:documentation>Procurement team considers cost, delivery time and supplier reliability.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SignalJoin_ToPlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceOrder_ToUpdateDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update inventory system with expected delivery dates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceOrder_ToUpdateDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateDelivery_ToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateDelivery_ToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_ToInspect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_ToInspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_ToRecord</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_ToRecord</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_ToStore</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StoreStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_ToStore</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Store_ToUpdateLevels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Store_ToUpdateLevels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateLevels_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateLevels_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToMonitorMerge" sourceRef="Start_Monitoring" targetRef="Gateway_MonitorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorMerge_ToMonitor" sourceRef="Gateway_MonitorMerge" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_ToThresholdSplit" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reached_ToSignalSplit" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdSplit" targetRef="Gateway_SignalSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${thresholdReached}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReached_Loop" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdSplit" targetRef="Gateway_MonitorMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!thresholdReached}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignalSplit_ToAlert" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalSplit" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignalSplit_ToManualCheck" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalSplit" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Alert_ToSignalJoin" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheck_ToSignalJoin" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignalJoin_ToPlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalJoin" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrder_ToUpdateDelivery" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDelivery_ToReceive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_ToInspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_ToRecord" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_ToStore" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_StoreStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Store_ToUpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_StoreStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="End_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
